articles.title: Mohan Bhagwat in New York: Mamdani Opposes RSS Event, Mary Millben Hits Back | Raw Report
articles.description: A political controversy is brewing in New York over RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s August 29 event at Madison Square Garden.New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has said he does not support the planned gathering, describing the RSS vision as “exclusionary” and contrasting it with the pluralistic and secular India he says he grew up knowing. However, Mamdani also acknowledged that City Hall may not have jurisdiction to cancel a privately organised event.The event, billed as the “Universal Oneness Celebration,” is being organised by American Hindus for Engagement and Dialogue and is expected to bring together thousands of members of the Hindu-American community. Organisers say the programme focuses on shared heritage, interfaith dialogue and unity. Free Buses, 50,000 Scooties: Yogi’s Big Women Outreach Ahead of UP Polls | News18
articles.description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has announced a major set of women-focused initiatives as the state heads towards the 2027 Assembly elections.The UP Cabinet has approved the Lokmata Ahilyabai Matrushakti Yojana, providing free travel on Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation buses to women aged 60 and above. The scheme is expected to benefit tens of thousands of women every day and will cost the state government around ₹22.5 crore per month.At a separate event on August 26, Yogi Adityanath announced that 50,000 undergraduate female students will receive scooters in October-November. The initiative is linked to the Rani Lakshmibai Scooty Yojana, which was approved earlier this year for meritorious girl students.The announcements come less than a year before the expected 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, putting women-focused welfare and outreach at the centre of the political conversation.
